minecraft_bubble_column_up.description: front and threequarter frames are plain sky horizon over grass at every tick; top frames show only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile. no particles distinguishable from baseline noise (max pixel deviation ~2% of range).
minecraft_bubble_column_up.notes: only sub-threshold 1-3px luminance specks; effect likely not emitted within the captured window or is invisible at this scale.

minecraft_damage_indicator.description: a loose cluster of small dark red-brown heart-shaped sprites floating in the upper sky region at t3 on front and threequarter views; entirely gone by t8. top view shows only the dirt pile.
minecraft_damage_indicator.notes: sprites sit near the top edge of the capture frame, so the cluster may extend higher; only the rising tail is framed.

minecraft_dust_color_transition.description: a dense roundish puff of small square dust specks at the anchor on front and threequarter views; deep royal blue at t3, shifting toward violet and pink-magenta by t8 while thinning out, gone by t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.

shape: square specks in a round puff
motion: slow outward drift with hue shift
density: dense central cluster, thinning over time
persistence: t3 and t8, gone by t20

minecraft_dust_color_transition.notes: observed hue progression blue -> violet -> pink matches a color-lerping dust; a couple of pink stragglers appear at t8.

minecraft_entity_effect.description: about 4-7 spiral curl swirl sprites, bright orange with pale cores, scattered loosely in the sky region above the anchor at t3 on front and threequarter views; gone by t8.
minecraft_entity_effect.notes: sprites partly clipped at the top of the frame in the threequarter view.

minecraft_falling_spore_blossom.description: a sparse scatter of about 6-9 tiny green square specks floating mid-air at t3 on front and threequarter views; some show a slightly paler teal rim. a couple of residual specks at t8, none by t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.

persistence: t3, trace at t8, none by t20
texture_quality: flat blocky squares with slight shading

minecraft_falling_spore_blossom.notes: sparse specks near the capture noise floor; count is approximate.

minecraft_gust_emitter_small.description: a large pale curling vortex puff wrapping around the anchor at t3, seen on front and threequarter views: soft white-gray billows forming a spiral curl shape roughly a third of frame height. completely dissipated by t8. top view shows only the dirt pile.
minecraft_gust_emitter_small.notes: one-shot burst; the curl silhouette is the most distinctive feature.

minecraft_landing_lava.description: a few small bright orange-red molten splatter streaks lying flat on the grass at the anchor at t3 on front and threequarter views; a smaller residual speck persists at t8, nothing by t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.
minecraft_landing_lava.notes: low pixel count keeps this at the faint end though the streaks are distinctly saturated.

minecraft_raid_omen.description: a narrow vertical column of red spiral-sigil particles rising above the anchor at t3 on the front view; the threequarter view catches the top of the same red column partly clipped at frame top. gone by t8. top view shows only the dirt pile.

shape: spiral sigils in a vertical stack
scale_impression: small glyphs in a tall column

minecraft_raid_omen.notes: column extends past the top of the frame, so only its lower part is measured.

minecraft_smoke.description: two to three small dark gray-black blocky smoke puffs drifting in the sky region at t3 on front and threequarter views; nothing by t8. top view shows only the dirt pile.
minecraft_smoke.notes: darker than typical gray smoke; reads almost black against sky.

minecraft_sweep_attack.description: every front, threequarter and top cell equals the flat grass and sky baseline; top views contain only the persistent dirt piles. no arc, swoosh or blade trail is visible at any sampled tick.
minecraft_sweep_attack.notes: the sweep arc is a very short-lived effect; all three sampled ticks may fall outside its brief active window.

minecraft_wax_on.description: a cluster of golden-amber plus/cross-shaped sparkles hovering around the anchor at t3 and still present at t8 on front and threequarter views; gone by t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.

motion: nearly stationary hover with slight drift

minecraft_wax_on.notes: sparkle positions barely change between t3 and t8, suggesting a slow hover rather than a burst.

world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_EJECT_ITEM.description: an upward eruption burst at t3: many orange-yellow flame teardrop sprites mixed with dark gray-black smoke puffs around the anchor on the front view. by t8 the burst has cleared and a single small golden item sprite floats high in the sky on the threequarter view. top view shows only the dirt pile.

shape: flame teardrops plus smoke puffs plus small item sprite
scale_impression: medium burst, about two blocks tall
persistence: burst at t3, lingering item at t8

world_event_ANIMATION_VAULT_EJECT_ITEM.notes: the t8 residual reads as a single gold item suspended mid-air, consistent with an ejected drop.

world_event_PARTICLES_EYE_OF_ENDER_DEATH.description: at t3 a wide purple elliptical ring of small particles hangs high in the sky on the front view, with a few teal-green cube-like fragments nearby; by t8 the ring has dispersed into a broad horizontal spray of purple-magenta specks. top view at t3 shows a teal fragment block beside the dirt pile.

persistence: t3 to t8, gone by t20
texture_quality: fine small specks plus blocky fragments

world_event_PARTICLES_EYE_OF_ENDER_DEATH.notes: teal-green cube fragments read as physical debris pieces, not pure particles.

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_BECO.description: a wide burst of many bright cyan soul-flame licks rising over the anchor at t3 on front and threequarter views, each flame showing a white-cyan core; only a few stragglers remain at t8 and none at t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.

persistence: strong at t3, sparse at t8

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_BECO.notes: uniform cyan hue across all flames; the soul-fire-style palette is distinctive.

superheroes_black_flame.description: a pair of dark flame licks with pale-white cores hovering at the anchor on every tick of the front and threequarter views; at t20 the flames look slightly grayer. the t20 top view shows several large translucent dark and pale beige rectangular panels covering much of the grass, consistent with the flame billboards seen from above.

blend_appearance: opaque flames; translucent panels in top view

superheroes_black_flame.notes: top-view panels look like billboard quads viewed edge-on; top framing makes the effect read as haze rather than flame.

superheroes_goku_ki_aura.description: a compact saturated red blobby mass hovering at the anchor on every tick of the front and threequarter views; at t20 the mass has drifted down toward the grass and turned pale translucent pink-red. top view shows only the dirt pile.

motion: hovering, settles and fades by t20

superheroes_goku_ki_aura.notes: uniform flat red reads more like a solid energy mass than a layered aura halo.

superheroes_homelander_sun_debris.description: a tall dark vortex of black streaky shard particles spiraling around the anchor at t3, filling much of the upper front and threequarter frames with a tornado of sharp fragments, plus a dark speckled patch on the grass below. from the top at t3 the same event reads as a wide black shard splatter radiating across the grass. by t8 only pale gray-blue wispy shards remain, drifting.

scale_impression: huge, spans much of frame height
persistence: violent at t3, pale wisps at t8

superheroes_homelander_sun_debris.notes: largest burst in the batch; reads as a violent debris event rather than a glow effect.

superheroes_naruto_rasengan_swirl.description: a compact cluster of dark spiral-curl particles held at the anchor on every tick of the front and threequarter views; the curls are near-black with faint slate-blue edges at t3 and t8, fading to pale gray versions of the same curls by t20. top view shows only the dirt pile.

shape: spiral curls in a tight cluster

superheroes_naruto_rasengan_swirl.notes: effect stays locked at the anchor; the fade at t20 suggests decay rather than movement.

superheroes_soul_spark.description: a loose cluster of glowing cyan-white plus/star sparkles floating around the anchor on every tick; by t20 the sparkles have drifted down toward the grass and turned noticeably paler. top view shows only the dirt pile.

texture_quality: sparkle sprites with soft glow edges

superheroes_soul_spark.notes: soft luminous edges against the sky suggest an additive-style glow render.

vfxlab_smoke_plume.description: a pale gray-beige billowing smoke cloud sits at the top edge of the front frame on every tick, made of soft blotchy semi-transparent puffs; stable in position across t3, t8 and t20. from the top at t3 the plume reads as faint gray speckling over the dirt pile area.
vfxlab_smoke_plume.notes: only the cloud head is framed at the top edge; the rising column below it is out of view or too faint.
